title: Umbrella with Compact Discs 2
description: Compact discs arranged in horizontal rows and a cross-like vertical formation surround a large black umbrella viewed from above, set against layered silver-foil and lace-edged fabric. Magenta ribbon borders the bottom edge, with additional CDs lining the uppermost and lowest margins.
composition: umbrella centered above cross-shaped CD formation
dimensions_source: CD reference: 14 discs measured directly (2 rows of 7, top and bottom margins), diameters ~145px and ~135px native respectively, ~7% spread between rows. Visually confirmed real, unobscured discs, not automated detection. Estimated 2026-08-03.
